messages:
erin: Heads-up — customer @jordan_cust getting 403 on Billing page after org rename. Path: /orgs/ACME-prod/projects/456/billing. Can we triage?
jordan_cust: Yep. Clicking Billing -> Projects immediately shows a 403. Happened right after we renamed org from acme-inc -> acme-prod. API with service key still works for some endpoints, but console pages blocked.
sam_support: Sorry about that — can you paste the console request id and a curl repro? Also which user/role are you using in the console?
jordan_cust: Repro with curl (we obfuscated token):
```
curl -i -H "Authorization: Bearer [redacted]" \
  "https://console.redwood.com/orgs/ACME-prod/projects/456/billing"
HTTP/1.1 403 Forbidden
{ "error": "forbidden", "code": 403, "request_id": "req_abc123" }
```
erin: Request id from devtools is req_abc123. Affected user: jane@acme.com, role = "Billing Admin" assigned via Okta group "ACME-Billing" (SCIM provisioned).
maria_devops: Looks like the org rename can drop SCIM group displayName mappings if groups were renamed during the process. Can you run our internal rbac-check and paste output?
rbac-bot: rbac-check report for org ACME-prod: project 456 -> inheritance: ORPHANED; group-mapping: ACME-Billing -> NOT_FOUND; last_scim_sync: 2026-02-24T14:12:03Z; pending_actions: 1
sam_support: Kicking to eng-security for targeted resync. @engsecurity_lee can you confirm if we can run a targeted SCIM reapply for that org?
engsecurity_lee: I'll reproduce locally. If group displayName lost during rename, a targeted resync/relink is safe. Need customer consent to reapply SCIM bindings. @jordan_cust can you confirm?
jordan_cust: Confirmed — you have approval to run the SCIM reapply on our org. We're on Enterprise. Please proceed.
engsecurity_lee: Running targeted resync now (command: `internal-tools resync-scim --org ACME-prod --groups ACME-Billing`). ETA ~2m.
rbac-bot: resync job started (job_id: job_98765).
engsecurity_lee: Resync completed at 14:16:11 UTC. Reapplied group->role bindings for project 456. Cleared orphaned inheritance flag.
jordan_cust: Confirmed — Billing page loads and shows project list. Access restored, thank you :tada:
erin: Thanks everyone — closing thread. Filed internal follow-up: add org-rename SCIM reapply step to runbook and alert on SCIM mapping drift during rename.
